fullPassage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: general(형용사: 일반적인) → generally(부사: 일반적으로, 보통). 뒤의 동사 treated를 꾸미는 부사 자리
det.analysis: 형용사 general을 부사 generally로 바꿔요. 'it is __________ treated'에서 빈칸은 뒤의 동사 treated(치료되다)를 꾸미는 자리예요. 동사를 꾸미는 것은 부사이므로 generally(일반적으로)가 맞아요. '보통 행동 치료로 치료된다'는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 동사(treated)를 꾸미는 자리 → 부사 generally(-ly)

questions.passage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness __________ (characterize) by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by excessive acquisition.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: characterize(동사: 특징짓다) → characterized (과거분사, 수동: ~을 특징으로 하는). 'a mental illness (which is) characterized by ~'에서 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 과거분사
det.analysis: 동사 characterize를 과거분사 characterized로 바꿔요. 'a mental illness __________ by ~'는 앞의 명사 illness를 뒤에서 꾸미는 자리인데, 질환이 어떤 특징에 의해 '규정되어지는' 수동 관계라 과거분사 characterized가 필요해요. 'a mental illness (which is) characterized by ~(~을 특징으로 하는 정신 질환)'에서 which is가 생략된 형태예요.
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 꾸미며 '~되어지는' 수동 의미 → 과거분사 characterized

questions.passage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to own as many things as possible. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders __________ about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: forget painful memories=고통스러운 기억을 잊다 / earn more money=더 많은 돈을 벌다 / meet new people=새로운 사람을 만나다 / make better decisions=더 나은 결정을 내리다
det.analysis:
① forget painful memories: 기억을 잊는 것은 본문 내용이 아님
② earn more money: 돈 버는 것과 무관
③ meet new people: 사람을 만나는 것과 무관
④ make better decisions: 행동 치료는 환자가 물건을 유지·처분할지 '더 나은 결정을 내리도록' 도움 ←정답
det.tip: behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders __________ about keeping or getting rid → make better decisions(더 나은 결정)

questions.passage: Hoarding disorder is a mental illness characterized by the inability to get rid of possessions that have no use or value. It is often accompanied by "excessive acquisition," which means sufferers feel the need to __________. Hoarding behavior tends to start at an early age and becomes more and more extreme as the person grows older. Once it becomes a significant problem, it is generally treated with behavioral therapy, which helps hoarders make better decisions about keeping or getting rid of their belongings. However, as hoarding disorder can be a complex condition with multiple causes, this treatment often takes a long time, and additional methods may be required.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: travel to as many places as possible=최대한 많은 곳을 여행하다 / help as many people as possible=최대한 많은 사람을 돕다 / read as many books as possible=최대한 많은 책을 읽다 / own as many things as possible=최대한 많은 물건을 소유하다
det.analysis:
① travel to as many places as possible: 여행은 저장 강박과 무관
② help as many people as possible: 남을 돕는 것과 무관
③ read as many books as possible: 독서와 무관
④ own as many things as possible: 과도한 습득 = 최대한 많은 물건을 소유하려는 욕구 ←정답
det.tip: excessive acquisition = sufferers feel the need to __________ → own as many things as possible(최대한 많이 소유)
